players.product: OptiMOS MOSFETs, SiC modules, gate drivers

quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon AI & Technology Virtual Investor Conference 2026 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon IR (Daniel Gyory, Team Lead Investor Relations): of the order backlog (nearly EUR 30 billion at the last quarter close), about two-thirds, roughly EUR 20 billion, is due in the next 12 months; AI is 'a good portion' of it but the split has never been disclosed. AI design cycles give visibility of roughly one to two years, so the AI backlog is concentrated more on the short term, while some automotive customers order two, three years ahead. He cautioned that the backlog is not revenue guidance and may include double ordering or orders for products without enough capacity, but said he would not see a reason why this number should go down or weaken significantly.
quarterly_data.figure: roughly EUR 20 billion of the order backlog due in the next 12 months (about two-thirds)

quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon AI & Technology Virtual Investor Conference 2026 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon IR (Daniel Gyory): target operating model (mid-to-long-term, through the cycle, not tied to a year) is average growth of more than 10% per year, a segment result margin of roughly 25% (range high teens to high 20s) and an adjusted free cash flow margin of 10%-15%. He said the margin moved up significantly in calendar 2026 from the high teens to the low to mid-20 area, 'closing in' on the target model; fiscal 2027 guidance will be given on 10th of November.
quarterly_data.figure: growth more than 10% per year; segment result margin roughly 25%; adjusted free cash flow margin 10%-15%

quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon AI & Technology Virtual Investor Conference 2026 (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon IR (Daniel Gyory) on the new Bangkok backend site: the investment as of today is just a little bit over EUR 100 million ('We haven't reached the EUR 1.4 billion'); the site is scalable and can be expanded as necessary if order intake and customer demand are very good; the backend capacity it adds has not been disclosed; it improves resilience by letting Infineon control the backend process.
quarterly_data.figure: investment just a little bit over EUR 100 million so far
